 This Crl.P Is Filed U/S.482 Of Cr.P.C Praying To Quash
The Entire Proceedings In C.C.No.31022/2017 (Crime
No.72/2017) Registered By The Kodigehalli Police,
Bangalore For The Offence P/U/S 498A R/W 34 Of Ipc And
Section 3 And 4 Of Dowry Prohibition Act And Now Pending
On The File Of The Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Bangalore.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 Order
1. The petitioners are before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:

WHEREFORE, it is humbly prayer that this Hon'ble court be pleased to quash the entire proceedings in CC No.31022/2017 (Crime No.72/2017) registered by the Kodigehalli Police, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under section 498(A) read with 34 of Indian Penal Code and sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and now pending on the file of the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, in the interest of justice.
2. Despite the order dated 28.02.2024, none appears for the petitioners today also.
It appears that the petitioners are not interested in prosecuting the matter.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
